title: Recursive Sparse Attention: Million-Token Length Extrapolation at Logarithmic Cost
abstract: arXiv:2611.07232v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: At context lengths of about 1M tokens, dense attention is costly in prefill and decoding, and training typically relies on long documents, which become scarcer as the target length increases. Most sparse attention methods score all preceding blocks or tokens, so their selection cost per query is $O(L)$ at context length $L$; hierarchical selection reduces it to $O(\log L)$, but prior trainable hierarchical methods report accuracy only within their training length. We propose RecSA (Recursive Sparse Attention), which builds a tree over the KV cache in which each node summarizes its subtree with one key and one mean-pooled value. The keys come from one pooler per layer, shared by all levels and distilled from dense attention. Each level above the tokens selects at most $k$ candidates, so each query has $O(\log L)$ selection cost and reads $O(\log L)$ entries; the summaries of unselected candidates share one softmax with the exact tokens. translated_title: 递归稀疏注意力：以对数成本实现百万token长度外推
translated_abstract: 在约100万token的上下文长度下，稠密注意力在预填充和解码阶段成本高昂，且训练通常依赖长文档，而随着目标长度的增加，长文档变得越来越稀缺。大多数稀疏注意力方法会对所有前序块或token进行评分，因此在上下文长度L时每个查询的选择成本为O(L)；分层选择可将该成本降至O(log L)，但此前可训练的分层方法仅在训练长度内报告了准确性。我们提出RecSA（递归稀疏注意力），它在KV缓存上构建一棵树，其中每个节点用一个键和一个均值池化的值来概括其子树。这些键来自每层一个池化器，由所有层级共享，并从稠密注意力中蒸馏而来。token之上的每一层最多选择k个候选，因此每个查询具有O(log L)的选择成本并读取O(log L)个条目；未被选中的候选的摘要与精确token共享同一个softmax。
tldr: RecSA在KV缓存上构建递归树结构，利用从稠密注意力蒸馏且跨层级共享的池化键，使每个查询的选择成本降至O(log L)，从而以对数成本实现了百万token级的长度外推。
en_tdlr: RecSA builds a recursive tree over the KV cache with level-shared keys distilled from dense attention, reducing per-query selection cost to O(log L) and enabling million-token length extrapolation at logarithmic cost.
